Class Board

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingws.gc8.Model.Board.Board
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class Board extends Object implements Serializable
Represents the main game board containing all shared components. The Board manages the card decks for different eras, the rows of cards available for purchase, and the tracks for turn order and offers.

  • Constructor Details

    • Board

      public Board(int playerCount)
      Constructs a new Board and initializes all game components based on the number of players.

      This constructor initializes the card rows as empty lists, creates the decks as ArrayDeque, and sets up the tracks. Finally, it triggers the loading of the tribe deck.

      Parameters:
      playerCount - number of players participating in the game, used to calibrate the decks and tracks

    • Board

      public Board(Deque<Card> tribeDeck, List<Card> lowerRow, List<Card> upperRow, TurnOrderTrack turnOrderTrack, Deque<Card> era2BuildingDeck, Deque<Card> era3BuildingDeck, OfferTrack offerTrack)
      Constructs a Board with pre-initialized components

      This constructor is primarily intended for testing purposes, allowing the creation of a specific board state

      Parameters:
      tribeDeck - deck of tribe cards to be used
      lowerRow - list of cards to be placed in the lower display row
      upperRow - list of cards to be placed in the upper display row
      turnOrderTrack - pre-configured turn order
      era2BuildingDeck - deck containing Era 2 building cards
      era3BuildingDeck - deck containing Era 3 building cards
      offerTrack - pre-configured offer track

  • Method Details

    • loadTribeDeck

      public void loadTribeDeck(int playerCount)
      Loads the tribe deck by parsing character and event cards from JSON files.

      This method reads cards from `character_cards.json` and `event_cards.json`, filters them based on player count, and organizes them by era. Final event cards are placed at the bottom of the deck. The deck is then shuffled by era before being composed into the final tribe deck structure.

      Parameters:
      playerCount - the number of players, used to filter cards with player restrictions
